lines.text: Guilty thou art of murder and of theft,
lines.meaning: Opportunity, you are guilty of murder and theft,
of lying under oath (perjury) and of bribing others to do so (subornation),

lines.text: Guilty of treason, forgery, and shift,

lines.meaning: you are an accomplice (accessary) to them all, because it is your nature,

lines.text: To all sins past, and all that are to come,
lines.meaning: to every sin committed so far and every one still to come,

lines.text: From the creation to the general doom.
lines.meaning: from the creation of the world to the Last Judgement (the general doom).

summary: Lucrece accuses Opportunity of being an accomplice to every crime there has ever been.
